prompt: What makes a codespace reproducible — the same tools and extensions for everyone who opens one?
explanation: The dev container pins the image, tools, extensions, and settings as code in the repository. Everyone’s codespace builds from that definition, ending "works on my machine" stories.

options.text: A dev container definition committed to the repository (`.devcontainer/`)
Each developer configuring their own machine identically
A wiki page listing the required tools
Nothing — codespaces pick random tool versions
